notes.title: Should Emery Become a Paper World?
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]While working on Emery’s hubworld, I realized it feels a little empty  like there’s more potential waiting to be unlocked. That’s why I’ve been exploring a new idea: what if Emery’s world was made of paper, cardboard, and other handmade objects?[/p][p]This could make the hubworld feel more alive, layered, and fun to explore.[/p][p]I’d love to hear what you think about this possible new direction. Your feedback will help shape the future of Emery![/p][p][/p][p]Don’t forget to wishlist Emery if you haven’t already.[/p][previewyoutube="ZHwQZ8Te2-Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]

notes.title: Feathers in the Works
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It’s been a while since I’ve posted an update here, and I wanted to be honest with you all about why.

Game development isn’t always sunshine and smooth progress. Sometimes it's exciting and full of momentum  and other times, it’s a quiet grind, where progress is steady but not always flashy. With a small team of just two people, things naturally take more time. Life happens, doubts come and go, and not every week brings something show worthy.

That being said, the game is absolutely still in development! I’ve been working on a lot of new animations and systems that I want to get just right before sharing them. This project means a lot to me, and I’d rather take the time to make it great than rush content just to stay visible.

Going forward, I’ll be focusing more on building the game itself rather than posting as frequently as before. I still plan to share updates when there’s something meaningful to show  but right now, the priority is simply making the best game I can.

Thanks so much for your patience and continued interest. Your support truly means the world to me and helps keep the motivation alive

More to come 
 just at the right time. 

- Maik

notes.title: Bringing the Hub World to Life – First Music Track!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The hub world is a special place in my game it’s where your adventure begins, where you explore new areas, and where the world truly comes to life. And now, it finally has its own theme music! 🎵

I wanted this track to feel happy, bouncy, and full of energy, giving that fun oompa vibe as you explore. Take a listen and let me know what you think!

[previewyoutube=Yi85yEkiCgU;full][/previewyoutube]

Your feedback is super important to me, so drop a comment and tell me how it sounds! And stay tuned—next time, I’ll share how this track evolves as development continues.

Thanks for being part of this journey! 😊

notes.title: Meet the Bird Brain Behind Emery! 🐦🎮
notes.content:
Hi, I’m Maik, the developer behind Emery! I’m 29 years old and currently living in the Netherlands. By day, I work as a logistics employee, but my dream has always been to create my own 3D platformer, especially inspired by classics like Donkey Kong 64, Super Mario 64, and Banjo-Kazooie. 

While I handle the music, 3D and a part of the 2D art (with some help), the only thing I don’t do is the Unity #C/ coding and a part of the 2D art. It’s a challenging journey, but I’m dedicated to making this game something truly special. Thanks for believing in my project and wishlisting it 

I really appreciate your support! Feel free to ask if you have any questions or want to know more about me. I’ll keep you updated through this channel, and you can also check out my YouTube channel for more updates.
